summary: Students in households under 185 percent of the poverty line are eligible for free or reduced-price lunch.
realLife: Students in households with incomes under 185 percent of the poverty threshold are eligible for free or reduced-price lunch under the National School Lunch Program.
sources: NCES, Fast Facts: Public school students eligible for free or reduced-price lunch: https://nces.ed.gov/fastfacts/display.asp?id=898
inGame: the household's income record against the poverty threshold, and the school lunch program as a budget line. needs: a lunch eligibility fact.

turns.what: A household above the line, paying full price.
A household just under the line, eligible for reduced price only.
